journeyTemplate.blurb: Meet me this week and record your interview. Those two get everything else moving.

milestones.detail: About an hour, to go through this whole list together. Pick any time this week that suits you.
milestones.notePrompt: Anything you want to cover when we meet? (optional)
steps: Pick a time on the booking page below. You get a calendar invite straight away.
Bring anything you already have: your ABN, your Working With Children Check, your insurance.
milestones.title: Book a time with me this week

milestones.detail: About 45 minutes. A voice memo is fine, a video is even better. Talk the way you'd talk to a parent. Stories are gold. Skip any question you don't want to answer. Your words become the website, the ads and the posts.
milestones.notePrompt: Or paste a link to your recording
steps: YOU AND WHY. 1. What happened in your own life that led you to counselling? 2. When did you first think, "kids this little need this"? Tell me about that moment. 3. What does ROR (Raw, Open, Ready) mean to you? 4. What do you wish you'd known when your boys were 4 to 6?

THE PARENTS YOU'RE FOR. 5. Describe the parent who walks in your door. What's their week like? 6. What do parents say to you when they're at the end of their rope? Their actual words. 7. What have they usually tried already that hasn't worked? 8. What are parents scared of, or embarrassed about, when it comes to their child's big feelings? 9. What do they want to feel by the end of a term?

THE KIDS. 10. Tell me about a "spicy" child, a "sparkly" child, an "energy bunny" and a quiet one. How does each one show big feelings? 11. What does a shy child need on their first day? 12. What's a moment with a child you'll never forget? (No names.)

THE TOOLS AND THE CLASS. 13. Walk me through a class, from the moment they arrive to the moment they leave. 14. Pick 3 tools. For each one: what's it called, what's it for, and how would you explain it to a 4-year-old? 15. Why play, clay and paint, and not sitting down and talking? 16. Why two weeks per tool? Why a term at a time? 17. What goes in the take-home guide? What should a parent do with it?

TRUST AND THE HARD QUESTIONS. 18. How is this different from therapy? When would you send a family somewhere else? 19. What would you say to a parent who thinks their child is "too much" for a group? 20. What can a parent honestly expect after one term? What won't change? 21. How do you keep kids safe and the room calm with 10 little ones?

QUICK-FIRE. 22. Finish this: "Tiny ROR is for the parent who…" 23. Finish this: "Let them ror means…" 24. One thing a parent could try tonight with a big feeling. How would you teach it in 30 seconds? 25. Anything I haven't asked that parents should know?
milestones.title: Record your interview

uploadOptions.hint: Files up to 25MB. A longer recording: put it in Google Drive or Dropbox and paste the link below.
uploadOptions.title: Upload your recording

tror-insurance.detail: Insurance that covers group classes for children. Upload the certificate, or tell me where it's up to if it's still on its way.

tror-interview.detail: About 45 minutes. A voice memo is fine, a video is even better. Talk the way you'd talk to a parent. Stories are gold. Skip any question you don't want to answer. Your words become the website, the ads and the posts.

tror-meta.detail: The account your Facebook and Instagram ads run from. Set it up at business.facebook.com, then add me as a partner, so I can run the ads without your login.

tror-parent-chats.detail: Names of 5 to 8 local parents with kids aged 4 to 6 who'd have a 15-minute chat with me. Ask them first. What they say shapes the website and the ads.

tror-parents-stay.detail: Do parents stay in the room during class, or drop off and come back?

tror-photos-luisa.detail: A few good photos of you, ideally laughing. For the About section of the website.

tror-policies.detail: Your rules, in your words. I'll turn them into a short policy for the website and the booking page.

tror-prices.detail: $40 for a single class. $280 for a term, or 4 payments of $70. A $20 taster that comes off the term.

tror-shoot-families.detail: 2 or 3 families with kids aged 4 to 6 for a fun 1-hour play photo shoot in early December. Each family signs the consent form first.

tror-socials.detail: Pages for Tiny ROR. If you have them, paste the links. If not, we set them up when we meet.

tror-stripe.detail: Stripe takes the parents' payments and pays them straight into your bank account. Set it up yourself at stripe.com, in the business name.

tror-taster-dates.detail: About 5 dates for the $20 taster classes, in the January school holidays.

tror-tools.detail: The real names of your tools: at least the first 4, ideally all 16 for the year. A one-line note on what each is for helps too.

tror-venue.detail: Where the Ballina classes and the tasters will run. Parents will want to know before they book.

tror-wwcc.detail: Your WWCC number goes on the website. Parents look for it.
